Title: Philokalia ton hieron neptikon (the Philokalia of the holy neptic fathers), edited by Panagiotes Ath. Tzelatis; Volume Two
Creator: compiled by Macarius of Corinth and Nikodemos the Hagiorite (first printed Venice, 1782); this edition prepared by Panagiotes Ath. Tzelatis
Publisher: En Athenais: ek tou typographeiou Paraskeua Leone
Publication Date: 1893
Rights: Public Domain (published 1893, more than 95 years ago; public domain by date under the project's rolling rule; the item carries no rights field, so the date rule alone applies)
Language: grc
Source: Internet Archive item Dobrotolyubie1793 (https://archive.org/details/Dobrotolyubie1793), the item's own Φιλοκαλία Τόμος Β΄ (1893)_djvu.txt full-text OCR derivative; contributing library per the item metadata: not named in the item metadata; host metadata date: 1793. Fetched directly (curl/urllib, raw bytes) by the Library thread (Era VIII pass), 2026-10-23. sha256 of the raw fetched bytes: 4acb3d0fccd315e43b2a10311fde5519f630a1b17544df01ae4a48f6cd7cd95f.
Provenance note: Header prepended by the Library thread; nothing else altered, no OCR error corrected, nothing retyped. One of several files in an individual upload titled for the Slavonic Dobrotolyubie of 1793; this file is a separate scan of the Athens 1893 Philokalia, volume two, as its title page shows (Tomos deuteros, Athens, Leones press, 1893). The item's OCR ran with a Bulgarian model beside Greek, so Cyrillic letters stand for Greek capitals in about 5 per cent of letters, most of them in headings.
Content note: The second volume of the 1893 Philokalia, from Peter of Damascus through Symeon the New Theologian, Gregory of Sinai, Gregory Palamas, Kallistos and Ignatius Xanthopoulos and the later hesychast writers, ending the anthology.
